decision: Retain this distinct dataflow change and stop this round: >1ms full-frame gain against both same-DLL controls.
old_work: Every fixed-step hostile muzzle input called enemy_port_offset -> enemy_component_pose -> display_enemy, constructing full display records when only one muzzle was requested.
replacement: native_execution_session.prepare_geometry calls execution_enemy_port_offset for hostile weapons. Live known components use the existing mathematical component solver. Dead/frozen/unknown components retain the original path. Full display records are still built by actual display consumers.
semantics: Same muzzle math and full display/frozen schemas; no demand filtering, new cache, changed logic rate, shot count, damage/drop rule or quality.
diagnostic_nesting: before/prepare/tick/after/snapshot are siblings within advance. display_enemy is within prepare; component_pose is within display_enemy. queue_damage_total is within game_tick; damage_merge_scan is within queue_damage_total. Instrumented diagnostics are not acceptance timings.
queue_scan_decision: No implementation: exclusive scan only 0.433ms/frame, below required potential.
limits: One A/B/A; not a long-term or percentile improvement guarantee.
Do not add gains across independently timed rounds or compare their absolute frame means as controlled regressions.
